name: JOANNA (GIOVANNA) MORACA
bioAdditions: Giovanna was baptized on 1 March 1721, daughter of Francesco Moraca and Lucrezia Manfrida (S1). Her godfather, Don Giovanni Battista Bonaccia of Naples, stood by proxy. She married Bernardo Cicco in 1738, at about 16 (S2). Her parents are new to the tree.
